authority: _validation_registry.json is the executable source of truth; _repo_validation_matrix.json is generated from it.

HARD_FAIL.meaning: Direct production, source-integrity, safety, workflow, or delivery threat.

STRONG_WARNING.meaning: Material quality, ingestion, indexing, accessibility, or performance degradation.

SOFT_WARNING.meaning: Maintainability, documentation, style, or low-risk quality concern.

INFO.meaning: Metric, observation, historical evidence, or optimization note.

scope_definitions.CONTAINER: Runnable in the standard container without provider credentials.
scope_definitions.LOCAL_ONLY: Requires deployed URL, browser runtime, credentials, or operator environment.

core.description: Pure default release-blocking checks; no mutation and no external provider dependency.

release.description: Full container release proof: core plus source immutability, hygiene, and deterministic build.

strict.description: Release proof plus advisory checks; strong warnings are promoted to failure.

advisory.description: Non-blocking quality and ingestion warnings only.

local.description: Full release proof plus deployed Playwright click audit.

audit.description: Collect-all execution of every active and on-demand validator; local-only checks are deferred unless explicitly enabled.

social.description: Public-signal normalization and candidate loop validation.

llm.description: LLM export, answer-block, entity-graph, and citation-target validation.

homepages.description: Homepage-only schema and assistance boundary checks.

canonical-data.description: Protected canonical source static and runtime immutability checks.

postrelease.description: Pure post-build structural verification; no content release or mutation.

validators.title: Validation registry admission and matrix parity
validators.risk_prevented: Unregistered, duplicated, mutating, or misclassified validators can create false confidence and pipeline drift.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: No individual domain validator can prove that the validation system itself is complete and centrally governed.

validators.title: Validation severity policy self-test
validators.risk_prevented: A runner regression could silently treat a hard failure as a warning or turn advisory findings into false release blockers.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Registry schema validation proves classification data, but only this self-test proves the executable severity policy.

validators.title: Repository authority contracts
validators.risk_prevented: Wrong repository identity, updater, lifecycle, or command contracts can invalidate the entire release.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: This check validates repo-local constitutional files and package command presence.

validators.title: Canonical-domain contract
validators.risk_prevented: Incorrect canonical routing can misdirect users and destroy citation attribution.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Render checks do not prove the approved canonical domain mapping.

validators.title: Vertical-key integrity
validators.risk_prevented: Invalid vertical keys can route content to the wrong generator, URL, or canonical domain.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Schema and render checks cannot reliably infer intended taxonomy ownership.

validators.title: No doubled vertical slugs
validators.risk_prevented: Doubled path segments create broken and duplicate public routes.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Generic href validation does not guarantee source slugs are normalized.

validators.title: Canonical-data static write guard
validators.risk_prevented: Unapproved scripts could overwrite protected canonical source files.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Runtime immutability only tests known commands; static inspection finds hidden write paths.

validators.title: Canonical-data runtime immutability
validators.risk_prevented: A normal build could silently mutate protected canonical data.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Static analysis cannot prove runtime behavior of dynamic paths.

validators.title: Live hub contract
validators.risk_prevented: Missing or malformed public hubs break primary user and crawler entry points.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Generic page inventory does not prove hub-specific contracts.

validators.title: Insight page contract
validators.risk_prevented: Malformed insight pages can ship incomplete or uncitable content.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: The programmatic atom gate does not cover every legacy insight rendering invariant.

validators.title: Medium article contract
validators.risk_prevented: Malformed syndicated articles can break canonical handoff and publication surfaces.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: General site checks do not verify Medium-specific attribution and cliffhanger rules.

validators.title: Archive schema contract
validators.risk_prevented: Archive indexes without publisher/canonical schema weaken discovery and routing.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Homepage and insight validators do not inspect archive-only pages.

validators.title: Citation Velocity cumulative plan contract
validators.risk_prevented: Monitor history, recommendations, wins, ownership, or required fixes could be omitted or falsified.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: No generic content validator checks the exact cumulative monitor ledger and acceptance contracts.

validators.title: Programmatic content admission gate
validators.risk_prevented: Thin or boilerplate pages without a defensible data atom could ship.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Render validity does not prove citation-worthiness, unique metadata, schemas, or atom uniqueness.

validators.title: Deterministic insight manifest
validators.risk_prevented: Manifest drift can orphan or duplicate generated insight routes.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Inventory parity alone does not prove deterministic source-to-route mapping.

validators.title: Homepage schema contract
validators.risk_prevented: Primary landing pages could lose required structured data.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Generic HTML integrity does not validate homepage schema semantics.

validators.title: Homepage Find a Provider and editorial architecture
validators.risk_prevented: Old CTA copy or missing provider routing can undermine conversion.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: General safety regexes do not fully cover homepage-specific assistance language.

validators.title: Sitemap and inventory parity
validators.risk_prevented: Published pages can become undiscoverable or stale URLs can remain indexed.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Route existence does not prove sitemap parity.

validators.title: Public inventory contract
validators.risk_prevented: Unexpected, quarantined, or missing routes could enter the release.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Sitemap parity alone cannot validate admission state and route inventory semantics.

validators.title: Executable-file permissions
validators.risk_prevented: Required shell or executable scripts may become unusable after extraction.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Source and render validators do not inspect file mode contracts.

validators.title: Rendered hierarchy integrity
validators.risk_prevented: Atlas, cluster, and insight pages can be missing, thin, or disconnected.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Href checking alone does not validate hierarchy-specific content and backlinks.

validators.title: Rendered href and asset integrity
validators.risk_prevented: Broken internal links or assets create user and crawler failures.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Hierarchy validation inspects only governed route relationships, not every rendered href/src.

validators.title: Content safety boundaries
validators.risk_prevented: Medical, legal, dental, immigration, or neuro content could cross advisory boundaries.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Content structure validators cannot determine prohibited claims and required disclosures.

validators.title: CI and release workflow contract
validators.risk_prevented: CI could rebuild unvalidated output, use unsafe rebases, or mutate on push.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Package scripts do not prove workflow trigger and artifact-consumption behavior.

validators.title: Browser proof contract
validators.risk_prevented: The required representative browser proof could be underspecified or silently reduced.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Static page checks cannot prove the browser test plan itself remains complete.

validators.title: Repository and packaging hygiene
validators.risk_prevented: Logs, nested repos, generated junk, or backup artifacts can contaminate the baseline ZIP.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: ZIP integrity cannot prove the source tree was clean before packaging.

validators.title: Deterministic build comparison
validators.risk_prevented: Identical source could generate different public output or freshness churn.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: A single successful build cannot prove determinism.

validators.title: Public-signal ingestion health
validators.risk_prevented: Degraded Reddit or public-signal intake can reduce query discovery coverage.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Release content can remain structurally correct even when an external signal source is temporarily degraded.

validators.title: Query fanout coverage warning
validators.risk_prevented: Weak fanout coverage can reduce discoverability and cluster depth.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: This is a quality degradation, not a direct production break.

validators.title: IndexNow workflow readiness
validators.risk_prevented: Search-engine notification may be delayed or incomplete.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: The site and validated artifact remain functional without IndexNow submission.
validators.retirement_reason: Legacy expectations required push-triggered distribution rebuilds and direct validate:all coupling, which conflict with the one-validated-artifact lifecycle.

validators.title: Distribution input contract
validators.risk_prevented: Deployment could consume missing or malformed distribution inputs.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Release validation does not require deployment credentials or provider files.

validators.title: Distribution script contract
validators.risk_prevented: Distribution scripts could violate exact-artifact deployment rules.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Workflow validation does not inspect every distribution helper invariant.

validators.title: Query compiler contract
validators.risk_prevented: Compiled query pages could lose source mappings or canonical routing blocks.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Only required after query compilation or related mutation.

validators.title: Release batch source/live parity
validators.risk_prevented: A batch release could omit or add unintended structural pages.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Only meaningful immediately after batch mutation.

validators.title: Release batch workflow contract
validators.risk_prevented: Batch mutation could bypass validation or push unsafe state.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: The general workflow check does not inspect all release-batch-specific rules.

validators.title: Public signal processing contract
validators.risk_prevented: Public-signal normalization could create unmapped, unapproved, or externally mutating content work instead of governed Velocity source rows.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Only meaningful after the signal-processing queues and Velocity source index exist.

validators.title: Retired external candidate export contract
validators.risk_prevented: Candidate payloads could violate the Velocity-to-LKG authority boundary.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Core release does not require a newly generated candidate payload.
validators.retirement_reason: Velocity owns all generated pages and no longer exports content to an external repository.

validators.title: LLM export contract
validators.risk_prevented: LLM export files could be empty or malformed.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Only required after the LLM export build lane runs.

validators.title: Answer block export contract
validators.risk_prevented: Generated answer blocks could be missing required fields.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Only required after answer block generation.

validators.title: Entity graph export contract
validators.risk_prevented: Entity graph output could contain broken references or invalid records.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Only required after entity graph generation.

validators.title: Citation target export contract
validators.risk_prevented: Citation target output could be empty or malformed.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Only required after citation target generation.

validators.title: Deployed public click audit
validators.risk_prevented: Static validation cannot prove real HTTP, console, viewport, and navigation behavior.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Requires a deployed base URL and Playwright browser runtime.

validators.title: Velocity-only full-scope counts and regression
validators.risk_prevented: Missing Velocity state/support pages or monitor regression fixtures.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Existing page and monitor validators do not prove the combined full-scope counts, source inventory, candidate inventory, and June 19 regression fixtures.

validators.title: Primary-source and claim registry integrity
validators.risk_prevented: Regulated or numeric pages could ship with missing, dangling, or malformed provenance records.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: The content-atom gate proves structure and uniqueness, not source identity, claim linkage, retrieval dates, or recheck governance.

validators.title: Velocity-to-canonical routing law
validators.risk_prevented: Velocity pages could answer users without routing them to the correct canonical directory, ranking, state guide, or transactional destination.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Canonical-domain mapping alone does not prove above-fold, contextual, decision-artifact, and end-module routing on every eligible rendered page.

validators.title: Network identity and crawler access contract
validators.risk_prevented: Search and LLM crawlers could be blocked or receive misleading network identity markup.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Generic robots and schema validators do not prove the explicit eight-agent policy or the prohibition on cross-brand sameAs misuse.

validators.title: Retired external page candidate package
validators.risk_prevented: The 412 canonical page families could be undercounted, duplicated, mislabeled as complete, or lose their external repository blockers.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: The legacy LKG validator does not prove the full eight-family, 412-route network overhaul package.
validators.retirement_reason: The 412 routes are rendered in Velocity and are no longer external candidate specifications.

validators.title: Backlink evidence and search-resubmission contract
validators.risk_prevented: A disavow file could fabricate harmful domains or the resubmission package could omit the approved network properties and priority URLs.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Distribution checks validate generated URL artifacts but not evidence-bound disavow generation or six-domain credentialed submission readiness.
validators.failure_action: record warning, obtain exports or credentials, and rerun

validators.title: Velocity-only architecture and 412-page release
validators.risk_prevented: State/support pages, CTA migration, disavow evidence, or LKG retirement could be incomplete.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: This is the cross-layer acceptance contract for the approved Velocity-only overhaul.

validators.title: Programmatic substance, evidence depth, similarity, and word-count gate
validators.risk_prevented: Scaled template pages can ship with duplicate answers, shallow authority links, or insufficient page-specific substance.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: The atom gate checks structural uniqueness but not source depth, similarity concentration, or state-page word counts.
validators.failure_action: run self-healing repair, rescore, and stop release if the page still fails

validators.title: GitHub Actions trigger, data, secret, artifact, and manual-run trace
validators.risk_prevented: Manual or scheduled workflows can fail after deployment because triggers, variables, artifacts, or runtime prerequisites drift.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Syntax-only workflow checks do not prove artifact lineage or manual-run prerequisites.
validators.failure_action: stop release and repair the workflow contract

validators.title: Append-only Citation Velocity monitor ledger integrity
validators.risk_prevented: New weekly runs can be rejected by frozen totals or historical monitor records can be silently changed.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: The prior master-plan validator mixed content acceptance with exact historical counts and did not enforce append-only record hashes or run arithmetic.
validators.failure_action: reconcile metadata, repair malformed new records, or restore mutated historical records before release

validators.title: Public route, browser assertion, and click-audit parity
validators.risk_prevented: A declared browser suite can drift from the runner, route manifest, CTA labels, or representative state-page families.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Count-only browser validation does not prove each route/device case or declared assertion is implemented by the runner.
validators.failure_action: repair the route manifest, browser contract, or runner before release

validators.title: Rendered state-page depth, authority, FAQ, and CTA gate
validators.risk_prevented: Source rows may pass while rendered state pages remain thin, stale, missing authority cards, or missing visible FAQs and provider CTAs.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Source-level atom and similarity checks do not prove the final HTML contains the expected depth and visible evidence surface.
validators.failure_action: rerun the self-healing source pass, rebuild, and stop release until all rendered pages pass

validators.title: GitHub Actions YAML syntax and top-level shape
validators.risk_prevented: A malformed workflow file can pass token-based trace checks but fail before any GitHub Actions job starts.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: String-based workflow lineage checks do not parse YAML.

validators.title: Future monitor run append compatibility self-test
validators.risk_prevented: A valid new weekly monitor run can break release because a validator silently freezes historical cumulative totals.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Validating only the current ledger does not prove that an appended future run is accepted while historical hashes remain immutable.
validators.failure_action: repair dynamic ledger validation before accepting new monitor data

validators.title: Page Release Law across every admitted public route
validators.risk_prevented: A page can be admitted or released without complete traceability, correct canonical output, sitemap presence, or applicable evidence requirements; future routes can also be blocked by a frozen total.
validators.why_existing_checks_do_not_cover: Existing validators enforce individual route, sitemap, substance, and inventory concerns but do not express one authoritative release law over every admitted route.
validators.failure_action: repair durable source, generator, registry, or workflow code and rebuild before release

lineage_policy.authority: _validation_registry.json is the executable source of truth for validation selection, dependency order, prerequisites, outputs, severity, and mutation boundaries.
lineage_policy.dependency_rule: Dependencies are included recursively and executed in topological order before dependents.
lineage_policy.prerequisite_rule: Missing required files trigger registered prepare_commands. Unregistered preparation is forbidden.
lineage_policy.mutation_rule: Validator commands may write only declared mutates_files. Source roots are hash-checked before and after each validator.
lineage_policy.output_rule: Declared produces_files must exist after a passing validator.
